verdict.rationale: Superpowers skills live as plain markdown files under `skills/` that are the harness-agnostic source of truth, can be committed to a project's repo, or distributed via the official `obra/superpowers-marketplace` marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace`), and are installable per-harness (Claude Code, Devin, Hermes, Codex, etc.) — matching all three distribution modes in the story. A runtime probe confirms real installation of an individual skill into a project directory via `npx skills add`.  missing for 10: no evidence of team/org-level governance (e.g., enforced versions across a team, permission controls for shared marketplace skills) or independent reporting on team-wide rollout experience.
